# AI Voice Agents for Law Firms
> Antek Automation builds AI voice agents for UK law firms from £497 setup, set up by Andy Norman and scoped to tasks such as overflow calls, evening calls, confirmations and document chasing.

## What this site covers
- Voice agents for high-street firms and small legal practices, scoped task by task
- Tasks that can be scoped: overflow calls, out-of-hours calls, appointment confirmation and document chasers
- No legal advice and no conflict checks, and the firm stays responsible for what is said
- Setup from £497 and from £97 a month
